title: Shell Manatee WHP: as-built drawings and 3D model
anonTitle: As-built drawings and 3D model of a wellhead platform, Caribbean
challenge: The wellhead platform needs a complete set of as-built drawings and a 3D model, about 5,500 deliverables, delivered on the EPC contractor's close-out schedule.
